caption: Conceptual CrossModalLab workflow. Stored predictions and symbolic ground truth feed a read-only dashboard; historical Smol representation analysis is a separate evidence stream.
interpretation: Separates behavior, logical ground truth and representation analysis.
limitations: Conceptual engineering diagram, not measured neural pathways or activations.

caption: Three strict-left-of premise sets for the same query R(A,C). Chains entail the query or its negation; a fork admits both query orderings.
interpretation: Undetermined is insufficient evidence, not false.
limitations: Symbolic illustration derived from verified logical definitions; not an empirical measurement or neural graph.

caption: Original, hash-verified stimuli for xc_ho_0011 entailed, contradicted and underdetermined development variants. Historical Qwen CE+ES5 generated Yes, No and No, respectively. Text premises are printed under each image.
interpretation: The fork answer No is unsupported despite being correctly formatted.
limitations: One exposed development family, not independent generalization. Images are original controlled benchmark stimuli; literal 2D shapes are disc and wedge.

caption: Recomputed Qwen balanced accuracy on the same 18 development cases/six families. Prompt is frozen Qwen with augmented abstention instructions; CE50 and CE+ES5 have different update budgets.
interpretation: Descriptive checkpoint differences; CE50 has zero Undetermined recall.
limitations: Repeated development inspection; no superiority claim. Paired CE+ES5 minus CE5 interval includes zero; no uncertainty bars are invented here.

caption: Class-specific recall recomputed from raw historical generations; every class has six development cases.
interpretation: Overall accuracy can hide failure to recognize insufficient evidence.
limitations: All classes share six dependent families; no independent sample or causal interpretation.

caption: Qwen confusion counts: rows are gold classes, columns are parsed predictions including Invalid. Each row sums to six; color scale is fixed at 0–6.
interpretation: Invalid outputs remain errors; CE50 parses all outputs but misses every fork.
limitations: Color represents counts, not confidence. These are prefix-parser outcomes, not exact-format acceptance.

caption: Semantic accuracy and exact-label compliance are recomputed separately. CE50 is 12/18 correct under the historical parser, 0/18 semantic-invalid and 0/18 exact-label compliant.
interpretation: Malformed outputs and incorrect answers are distinct failures.
limitations: Exact-label check trims outer whitespace only for classification; raw strings remain unchanged in the evidence.

caption: Exact observed CE, ES and CE+0.25 ES at five updates. No lines, smoothing or interpolated points are added.
interpretation: Each example supplies a different loss; this is a feasibility record, not a fixed-input learning curve.
limitations: Five selected updates cannot establish optimization convergence, method benefit or generalization.

caption: Per-update allocator maxima during the historical five-update pilot. Dedicated device capacity is 4096 MiB; allocator usage is distinct from sampled NVIDIA physical usage.
interpretation: Shows bounded observed allocator demand, not present admission or guaranteed safe future capacity.
limitations: Sampled physical memory peaks can miss transient allocations. This mission made zero new model forwards and passed no replication RAM admission.

caption: Historical SmolVLM2 last-token probe BA: layers 3/12/18/23 = 0.333333/0.518519/0.777778/0.740741. External probes used 81 training cases/27 families and 27 validation cases/nine families. Bars retain stored descriptive B=2000 family intervals.
interpretation: Label accessibility to an external probe, not evidence the VLM causally used that information.
limitations: Layer/selector/L2 selected on development data. BA independently checked from confusion counts; stored CI endpoints were not independently resampled in this mission. Separate from Qwen.

caption: Stored residual-row L2 norms for p0d2_ctrl_forward_chain_0010_forward_chain; four sampled layers, last-token selector, 2048 coordinates per row. Norms were rechecked against saved vectors.
interpretation: Magnitude of a vector in a recorded representation, not confidence, evidence flow or neuron importance.
limitations: One historical capture; separate Smol model, no Qwen attribution, no intervening or unmeasured layers.

caption: CPU feature-stratum balanced-accuracy ceilings on 9216 variants/six dependent families: audited nuisance features 1/3, single-modality oracle-parsed roles 2/3; joint symbolic oracle 1. Asterisks identify oracle-parsed role features.
interpretation: Logical non-entailment by one premise does not imply statistical label unpredictability.
limitations: Only listed features audited. These are design diagnostics, not VLM scores, exhaustive shortcut clearance or independent samples.
